Container.Name: wellness-gateway
Container.Overview: Always-on booking engine for Technogym mywellness classes. Keeps several mywellness accounts (the whole family), books each class the instant booking opens, joins the waiting list when a class is full and keeps watching it to grab a freed spot immediately, 24/7. Detects cancellations made in the official app/website. Sends Time Sensitive push notifications to the Wellness Booking iOS app (APNs) and offers a web UI with a first-run walkthrough. State lives in /config (credentials encrypted at rest).
Container.Changes: ### 2026-10-03 (v0.1.0) - First release: multi-profile engine (scheduler at opening time, waiting list, continuous watching of freed spots, weekly recurrences, per-club booking limit), external cancellation sync, APNs Time Sensitive push, web UI with walkthrough, REST API for the Wellness Booking iOS app.
Container.Requires: A Technogym mywellness account per person. For push notifications: an APNs key (.p8) from developer.apple.com placed in the appdata folder. For remote access: Cloudflare Tunnel or a reverse proxy with TLS.

Config.Name: Web UI / API port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI and of the API used by the iOS app.

Config.Name: Gateway data
Config.Description: State, encrypted mywellness credentials, log, APNs key.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address the iOS app uses from outside (e.g. https://booking.example.com). Shown in the walkthrough.

Config.Name: Trust proxy headers
Config.Description: true when behind Cloudflare Tunnel or a reverse proxy (client IP for login rate limiting).

Config.Name: APNs key path
Config.Description: Path (inside the container) of the APNs .p8 key. Leave empty to disable push.

Config.Name: APNs bundle id
Config.Description: Bundle id of the iOS app (APNs topic).

Config.Name: APNs production
Config.Description: true for TestFlight/App Store builds, false for Xcode debug builds.

Config.Name: Secret key (optional)
Config.Description: Passphrase used to encrypt mywellness passwords. If empty a random key is generated in /config/secret.key.
